compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug 5f44-63ed-5428-4da0 made the signing-key mode test skip where the platform does not honour POSIX permission bits. On Windows the key reports mode 0o666 because Windows does not implement POSIX bits, so the 0o600 guarantee the test checks on POSIX is not checked there at all.

## Approach
Decide whether rebar must restrict the op-cert signing key's access on Windows (an ACL limited to the owner) or document that Windows relies on the user profile's default ACLs. If the former, scope the implementation as a separate change with a Windows-runner test.

## Testing
Inspect the effective ACL of a freshly minted signing key on a Windows runner (icacls output recorded on the ticket); no code change for the decision itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The decision (restrict via ACL, or document the default) is recorded on this ticket with the observed Windows ACL of a new signing key (checked: icacls output in a ticket comment).
compiled_state.title: Decide whether rebar owes Windows signing-key confidentiality (ACL equivalent)
